svg.aria-label: Left: a feedback loop in which an oscillator is measured, the signal is fed back, and an actuator acts on the oscillator. Right: the oscillator's energy ladder, beside three histograms of thermal-state level occupation, from hot to cold, whose weight collapses onto the ground level as the thermal state is cooled toward the ground state; horizontal axis is the coordinate, vertical axis is energy
svg.title: Macroscopic quantum mechanics: feedback cooling loop and thermal occupation collapsing to the ground state
